trace.content:
You write job advertisements for a South African recruitment platform. You receive a hiring brief and return one advertisement as structured JSON.

The only source of facts is the brief. This rule is absolute:
- Every statement about the employer, pay, benefits, location, work mode, team, reporting line, process, dates or legal status must appear in the brief. If the brief does not state it, leave the field empty. Never invent a benefit, a salary, a team size, a closing date, a contact, or an equity, privacy or accessibility statement.
- You may rephrase, reorder, split and tighten the brief's content. You may not add facts.
- If the brief is thin, write a shorter ad. A short true ad beats a long padded one.

Write for the candidate reading on a phone:
- Title: the plain occupation name, under 60 characters, no internal grade codes, no words like rockstar or ninja.
- 300–650 words in total. Sentences under 25 words. Short paragraphs; bullets for duties, requirements and benefits.
- Address the reader as "you". Never write "the ideal candidate", "the successful applicant" or "he/she".
- If the brief gives a purpose or success measures, use them to tell the reader what they will own and what good looks like. If a requirement carries "needed because", you may state that reason.
- Each responsibility bullet names a specific activity and its object, and where the brief allows, its scale, audience or how success is measured. Not "support the team"; rather "reconcile 40 supplier statements each month and resolve queries with buyers".
- Three to six must-have requirements, each one needed by a duty you listed. Everything else goes under nice-to-have. Do not add years-of-experience figures the brief did not give.
- If pay is given, state it exactly, with what determines placement in the range if the brief says so.
- Say who the person reports to and the team size only if the brief gives them. Say remote, hybrid or on-site only if the brief does.
- Plain language. No "fast-paced", "work hard play hard", "self-starter", "rockstar", "passionate", "competitive salary", "market-related".
- Neutral wording: avoid aggressive, dominant, competitive, fearless and similar masculine-coded adjectives; avoid "young", "energetic", "recent graduate", "native speaker", "able-bodied", age ranges, and anything about family status, religion or health. State a requirement only if the duties need it.
- Include the employer's equity, POPIA and accessibility statements verbatim when the brief provides them; otherwise leave those fields empty.
- Include application steps, closing date and contact only as given. If the brief says the ad is published on a job board with its own Apply button, leave the contact field empty.

Output: the JSON structure requested, with empty strings, 0 or "unspecified" for anything the brief does not provide.

Title: French Customer Service Associate
Company: Concentrix
About the company: Discover why over 550,000 game-changers around the globe call Concentrix their “employer of choice.” Together, we will achieve greatness and unlock unlimited possibilities.
Purpose of the role: Was Accounting, Maths or Computer Literacy your favourite subjects in Matric? If you’ve ever solved a technical software issue, or precisely directed a lost friend to where you are then this French Customer Support Advisor role is perfect for you! As a French Customer Support Advisor on a technologically innovative campaign, you’ll need to catch on quick and embrace IT software rather than being intimidated by it, but just being “tech savvy” won’t fit the bill for this role. You’ll need to be an efficient and empathetic people’s person with the ability to hear what is not being said and be willing to go the extra mile to exceed customer’s expectations. We want quick thinking, problem-solvers and solution finders with resilience and a can-do attitude. This technical support role is challenging and requires a team player with maturity and commitment. Our ideal candidate is able to keep cool and collected under pressure, does not need micro-managing and is able to take ownership or hold others accountable and give recognition where needed. If you’re ready to take on the challenge then here’s your chance to make it count!
Responsibilities (hiring manager's notes):
  - Providing exceptional customer experience by addressing queries using multiple channels such as voice, email, chat and social media
  - Identifying the root cause of the customer’s software or system issues and using system analysis and testing techniques to solve low to moderately complex application or system issues
  - Developing and maintaining current knowledge of the campaign or account, support processes and procedures
  - Document each customer contact using our contact tracking systems in a clear, concise, and understandable format.
  - Prioritising work and balancing importance from the customer perspective and operational efficiency
  - Assisting customers in gaining the most value from their products and services
  - Identifying additional opportunities for solutions to benefit the customer's business needs
  - Using relevant software and tracking systems to record customer information, engagement or reported issues
  - Escalating unresolved customer issues to appropriate resources or stakeholders
  - Following through on commitments, communicating status of work, identifying and requesting assistance with barriers to progress
  - Adhering to scheduled shifts, structured environments, procedures, metrics and departmental goals
Must-have requirements:
  - Matric (Essential)
  - Minimum 6 months’ experience or knowledge in accounting, bookkeeping, financials, business intelligence, information technology, logistics, sales or customer relationship management
  - At least 6 months’ experience in a customer-facing role with the ability to build collaborative relationships with a service orientated attitude using positive language
  - Minimum 6 months’ experience in contact centre on international campaign (Essential)
  - Excellent command of English language - verbal and written
  - Business writing skills (Essential)
  - Strong listening, problem-solving and time management skills
  - Advanced computer literacy, typing skills and ability to navigate multiple screens (Essential)
  - Strong IT, PC navigational, problem-solving, administration and organisational skills
  - Ability to understand, analyse and navigate through learned technical systems
  - Ability to work late night shifts in a structured environment
  - Clear credit and criminal records
  - Availability work shifts between 3pm and 2am (Monday - Friday)
Nice-to-have:
  - Accountancy at Grade 12 level (Preferable but not essential)
  - Experience in web chat or non-voice environment (Preferred)
  - Digital, web chat, email exposure (Advantageous)
Location: ZAF Cape Town - 10 Rua, Da Gama St, Foreshore, Cape Town
Work mode: onsite
Pay: ZAR 16000.0 per month; basis: Base salary
Benefits:
  - Medical aid for main member/ medical insurance for employee and two dependents
  - Pension Fund
  - Subsidised transport
  - Team building activities and upskill training opportunities
  - Fantastic employee assistance programme (EAP)
  - World-class working environment, access to financial well-being sessions, will writing sessions, stress management sessions
  - Interactive and inclusive company culture
Employment equity statement: In accordance with South African law, only applicants who are legally authorised to work in the SA will be considered for this position and the appointment will be made in line with the company’s EE Plan. Concentrix is an equal opportunity employer. Concentrix evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability status or any other legally protected characteristic.
POPIA notice: If you are a California resident, by submitting your information, you acknowledge that you have read and have access to the Job Applicant Privacy Notice for California Residents
Note: the ad will be published on a job board with its own Apply button.

French Customer Service Associate

Concentrix

ZAF Cape Town - 10 Rua, Da Gama St, Foreshore, Cape Town · onsite

Salary: ZAR 16,000 – 16,000 per month. Base salary

About us
Discover why over 550,000 game-changers around the globe call Concentrix their "employer of choice." Together, we will achieve greatness and unlock unlimited possibilities.

About the role
You will support customers on a technologically innovative campaign, solving software and system issues and helping people get real value from their products. You will need to embrace IT software rather than be intimidated by it, and pair that with empathy and the ability to hear what is not being said. The role is structured and shift-based, and suits you if you stay calm under pressure, take ownership and work well with a team.

What you'll do
• Answer customer queries across voice, email, chat and social media, and give a clear resolution on each contact
• Identify the root cause of software or system issues, using system analysis and testing techniques to resolve low to moderately complex application or system problems
• Document every customer contact in the contact tracking systems in a clear, concise and understandable format
• Record customer information, engagement and reported issues in the relevant software and tracking systems
• Prioritise your work by balancing what matters to the customer with operational efficiency
• Help customers gain the most value from their products and services, and spot further solutions that meet their business needs
• Escalate unresolved issues to the right resource or stakeholder, and follow through on commitments by communicating progress and flagging barriers early
• Build and maintain current knowledge of the campaign, account, support processes and procedures
• Adhere to scheduled shifts, procedures, metrics and departmental goals

What you need
• Matric
• At least 6 months' contact centre experience on an international campaign
• At least 6 months' experience in a customer-facing role, building collaborative relationships with a service-orientated attitude and positive language
• Excellent command of English, verbal and written, including business writing skills
• Advanced computer literacy and typing skills, with the ability to navigate multiple screens and work through learned technical systems
• Availability for shifts between 3pm and 2am, Monday to Friday, including late-night shifts, and clear credit and criminal records

Nice to have
• Minimum 6 months' experience or knowledge in accounting, bookkeeping, financials, business intelligence, information technology, logistics, sales or customer relationship management
• Accountancy at Grade 12 level
• Experience in a web chat or non-voice environment
• Digital, web chat and email exposure
• Strong listening, problem-solving, time management, administration and organisational skills

What we offer
• Medical aid for main member or medical insurance for employee and two dependants
• Pension Fund
• Subsidised transport
• Team building activities and upskill training opportunities
• Employee assistance programme (EAP)
• World-class working environment, with access to financial well-being sessions, will writing sessions and stress management sessions
• Interactive and inclusive company culture

In accordance with South African law, only applicants who are legally authorised to work in the SA will be considered for this position and the appointment will be made in line with the company’s EE Plan. Concentrix is an equal opportunity employer. Concentrix evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability status or any other legally protected characteristic.

If you are a California resident, by submitting your information, you acknowledge that you have read and have access to the Job Applicant Privacy Notice for California Residents
